# CapVeri
> CapVeri is a CRE FinOps platform for commercial landlords. It works from CSV, Excel, and lease PDF exports to verify CAM reconciliation workflows without replacing the ERP.

Last updated: 2026-06-06

## Core Product
- [How It Works](https://www.capveri.com/product-tour): Walk through the export-to-verification workflow before starting a trial.
- [Pricing](https://www.capveri.com/pricing): Reconcile starts at $998/year with 80OFF; list price starts at $4,990/year for up to 25 rentable units. 80% off the first year.
- [Machine-Readable Pricing](https://www.capveri.com/pricing.md): Plain-text pricing file for AI agents and crawlers, generated from current Reconcile unit-based pricing.
- [Start Free Trial](https://www.capveri.com/): Run a first CAM audit without replacing Yardi or MRI and without API integrations.

## Product Features
- [Product Features](https://www.capveri.com/product/features): Feature hub for CapVeri CAM reconciliation software, covering export ingestion, lease review, deterministic calculations, tenant workflows, and reporting.
- [ERP export ingestion](https://www.capveri.com/product/features/ingestion-csv-excel): Upload CSV or Excel exports from Yardi, MRI, AppFolio, RealPage, or generic templates without API integrations.
- [Deterministic calculation engine](https://www.capveri.com/product/features/deterministic-calc-engine): Apply BOMA 2024 gross-up, caps, base year, occupancy, and tenant share math with reproducible outputs.
- [Reconciliation accuracy checks](https://www.capveri.com/product/features/leakage-detection): Get every charge right before statements go to tenants, with under-billed and over-billed positions surfaced inside the reconciliation.
- [GL Narrative Review Queue](https://www.capveri.com/product/features/ai-gl-analysis): CapVeri flags GL descriptions that may need review for CapEx/OpEx miscoding, non-recoverable expenses, and audit risk patterns before statements are sent.
- [Historical analysis](https://www.capveri.com/product/features/historical-analysis): Compare multi-year results, detect anomalies, and benchmark variance across periods and pools.
- [Lease extraction with required human review](https://www.capveri.com/product/features/lease-ai-with-review): Extract lease terms from PDF documents, including accounting basis (cash vs. accrual), cap type, gross-up settings, and admin fees, and require explicit user verification before calculations use any value.
- [Snapshot and campaign workflow](https://www.capveri.com/product/features/snapshot-and-campaign): Track calculation jobs, draft/finalized snapshots, and reconciliation campaign stages in one workflow.
- [Tenant portal](https://www.capveri.com/product/features/tenant-portal): Invite tenants to view reconciliation statements, track balances, and access their documents in a secure portal.
- [Dispute management](https://www.capveri.com/product/features/dispute-management): Support dispute filing, threaded comments, attachments, and resolution tracking for tenant challenges.
- [Tenant communications](https://www.capveri.com/product/features/tenant-communications): Send reconciliation notifications, statement delivery emails, and dispute updates to tenants.
- [SB 1103 and billing document workflows](https://www.capveri.com/product/features/sb1103-and-demand-letters): Produce California SB 1103 exports, demand-letter drafts for under-billed balances, and correction notes for clean or over-billed statements.
- [Append-only audit trail](https://www.capveri.com/product/features/append-only-audit-trail): Record reconciliation changes and finalized states in append-only audit records for defensible reporting.
- [One-click audit defense package](https://www.capveri.com/product/features/audit-defense-package): Bundle reconciliation statement, calculation trace, GL extract, and NDA into a single ZIP for tenant auditors.
- [Multi-format exports](https://www.capveri.com/product/features/multi-format-exports): Export tenant packets and supporting schedules in PDF, Excel, and CSV for downstream review and delivery.
- [Statement detail level advisor](https://www.capveri.com/product/features/statement-detail-advisor): Pre-export analysis flags overly granular line items and suggests strategic grouping to reduce tenant dispute risk.
- [Subscription pricing and checkout](https://www.capveri.com/product/features/pricing-and-checkout): The annual Reconcile plan includes a 30-day free trial. Checkout is self-serve. Access pauses if billing is missing.
- [Denominator change audit trail](https://www.capveri.com/product/features/denominator-audit-trail): Automatically detect and document when the denominator shifts, including RSF re-measurement, anchor tenant departure, and BOMA 2024 re-measurement, and show exactly how each tenant's pro-rata share moved and by how much.
- [Cumulative cap bank tracking](https://www.capveri.com/product/features/cap-bank-tracking): Track multi-year cap carryovers so excess operating expenses roll forward correctly across reconciliation periods.
- [Importable adjustment exports](https://www.capveri.com/product/features/importable-adjustment-exports): Export reviewed CAM adjustments as CSV and Excel files. Your team can check them before ERP import.
- [Anomaly alerts](https://www.capveri.com/product/features/anomaly-alerts): Flag unusual expense variances, outlier GL entries, and year-over-year deviations that may indicate errors.
- [NOI impact calculator](https://www.capveri.com/product/features/noi-impact-calculator): Model how reconciliation adjustments flow through to net operating income at the property and portfolio level.
- [Portfolio and board-ready reports](https://www.capveri.com/product/features/portfolio-board-reports): Generate executive-level summaries and board presentation materials across all properties in the portfolio.
- [Tax protest data package](https://www.capveri.com/product/features/tax-protest-package): Bundle CAM reconciliation data, expense histories, and supporting schedules for property tax protest filings.
- [RBAC and row-level isolation](https://www.capveri.com/product/features/rbac-and-rls): Protect organization data with role-based access and RLS-backed multi-tenant separation.

## Educational Resources
- [What Are CAM Charges](https://www.capveri.com/cam-charges): Definition, inclusions, exclusions, pro-rata share logic, and audit pitfalls.
- [CAM Reconciliation Guide](https://www.capveri.com/cam-reconciliation-guide): The primary guide for the year-end CAM reconciliation process, deadlines, statements, and common errors.
- [How to Calculate CAM Charges](https://www.capveri.com/resources/how-to-calculate-cam-charges): Step-by-step formula, worked examples, and core calculation logic.
- [CAM Reconciliation Example](https://www.capveri.com/resources/cam-reconciliation-example): Worked example showing a full annual true-up across a multi-tenant property.
- [CAM Glossary](https://www.capveri.com/glossary): Definitions for key CAM and CRE FinOps terms used across leases and reconciliations.
- [State CAM Compliance Guides](https://www.capveri.com/resources/states): Jurisdiction-specific CAM disclosure, documentation, and timing considerations.
- [CAM Expense Categories](https://www.capveri.com/resources/expenses/landscaping): Expense-category explainers covering recoverable, excluded, and controllable costs.

## About
CapVeri is an export-based verification layer, not a Yardi, MRI, RealPage, or AppFolio replacement.
